meta.name: aed:lead-bar
meta.description: Master switch. Set content to 'on' to enable. Without this meta tag the bar never renders.

json.description: Override the auto-detected phone/email and CTA. All fields optional — phone is auto-discovered from the first <a href='tel:'> in the DOM if not set.

phone.description: Phone number to promote. Auto-detected from the page if omitted.

email.description: Fallback email if no phone is configured or detected.

phoneLabel.description: Label rendered next to the phone number.

emailLabel.description: Label rendered next to the email.

showAfter.description: Pixels scrolled before the bar reveals. 0 = show immediately.

hideOnPaths.description: Paths where the bar should not appear.

dismissable.description: Show the close button (dismiss persists for the session).
